device.model: HD X110p (the v1.2.4 special NPVR-to-PVR transition build)
device.type: DVB-S2 HD single-tuner satellite receiver with Conax card reader and CI slot
device.soc: ALi M3606 (the maincode chunk's version "M3606 ", the seecode chunk's "M3606 SEE"; Application 1.0.0@M3606_DVBS2_SABBAT_20110413)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the maincode chunk's version; chip ID 0x3603 (chipId)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 (I2C 0x63 on the first hardware I2C master)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603, bypasses the EuP standby-on-AC-power-up flag ($fp = 0xDEADBEAD in M3602.start()), starts the SEE program at 0xA6000200, initializes the Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x63 (tuners.py, device.tunerModel), and opens its main menu OSD (~1,544 unique colours at 80 M instructions, panel " ON ", "noCH").

desc: Special transition firmware v1.2.4 for the Opticum HD X110p satellite receiver on the ALi M3606 SoC, enabling PVR functionality on non-PVR factory builds.
